title: chat.server.ts reads its system prompt, algorithm, products, shared docs, blog index and posture files from disk once at import and never refreshes them.
evidence: Root fix R24 (US-15 AC72): the system prompt, algorithm, products doc and both postures are one state, CHAT_PROMPT in app/lib/chat-system-prompt.server.ts; 'missing' names the files and every chat entry refuses (AC65). Left: the docs are read once per process from process.cwd(), with no reset seam (the createChatDocs(root) shape was not built); writing style and answer bank keep loadSharedDoc (Sentry report, chat answers without them); the blog index, knowledge overview and evidence keep their import-time load. app/lib/chat-router.server.ts:36 keeps its loadBlogIndex() call: loadBlogIndex is memoised (blog-index.server.ts), so it reuses the same array.
